# Tests left out of the runs on the CPU backend, one `PATTERN | REASON` per line (gtest patterns,
# several joined with `:`). A test belongs here when it has no meaning on this backend: it is
# counted as not applicable in the test report, with this reason, and it is not run. A test that
# only fails or is missing a feature does not belong here.
#
# A pattern that matches no test is an error (see .github/scripts/run_gtest.py).

*ApiParity*Test.*:*ApiParity*Test/*:ApiParityTest.* | The api is OpenFHE on the CPU backend, so a comparison of the api with OpenFHE proves nothing: these tests compare a device backend with OpenFHE
ChebyshevFixedManual.HazeMatchesOpenFheOracle:Repro/ChebyshevFixedManualCoworker.*:DropInputHost.DecryptSurvivesDroppedInput:HazeBootstrap.* | Regression tests of the haze backend, which compare it with the CPU engine
DropInputHost.DecryptSurvivesDroppedInputCuda | Tests the CUDA backend's device ciphertexts
ReducedNoise.SerializeDeserializeCudaReducedNoiseRoundTrip | Serializes a CUDA context, which needs a build with the CUDA backend
BootstrapToLevelTest.RefreshLandsOnTheCpuEngineLevel | Compares a device backend with the CPU engine
CKKSTest.ConcurrentHostShadowCopyOnWrite | Needs the concurrent-operations mode of the CUDA backend (FIDESLIB_CONCURRENT_OPS=1)
